summary: Full frontend smoke test of PWA NGO scheduler (Comunidade Putim). All core flows verified end-to-end: calendar rendering, month/year selection, day navigation, activity CRUD, settings customization, schedule preview, PDF download, localStorage persistence across reload, and mobile responsiveness.
passed: Home loads with calendar grid and month/year selectors
Prev/next month navigation buttons update grid
Clicking day-15 navigates to /atividade/:year/:month/15 with heading 'Dia 15 Sábado'
Division select shows all 6 default divisions (DE, DFJ, DMJ, DF, DS, 5 Div.)
Save activity persists, day cell shows blue-soft background + division label
Reopening day loads existing values; delete-activity-btn enabled
Empty activity input shows validation and stays on form
Cancel button returns to Home without changes
Settings dialog: header/community/quote/footer editable, add + remove division works, save persists
view-schedule-btn navigates to /programacao/:year/:month and preview renders
localStorage persistence verified after full page reload (both activity and settings)
Delete activity flow removes cell filled state
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): React console warning 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' emitted when division-select receives value. Consider initializing form.division to '' consistently or use defaultValue to silence. Does not affect functionality.
